newsitem.title: DENMARK: CYCLING-KNAVEN WINS TOUR OF DENMARK.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-KNAVEN WINS TOUR OF DENMARK.

text.p: Dutchman Servais Knaven won the Tour of Denmark on Sunday as Italy's Giovanni Lombardi took the final stage honours.
Race favourite Knaven finished 10 seconds ahead of Denmark's Peter Meinert. Another Dane, Jesper Skibby was third, a further 14 seconds back.
Lombardi won the 150 km closing section from Slagelse to Copenhagen by edging out Dutchman Leon Van Bon and Australian Robbie McEwen on the line.
Lombardi, winner of the second stage and first overall for a time, was ninth.
Knaven took charge of the race after coming second in Friday's time trial.
